# whoisalfaz.me — Full Content Index

## About

whoisalfaz.me is the technical portfolio and blog of Alfaz Mahmud Rizve, a Revenue Operations (RevOps) architect specializing in autonomous business infrastructure. The site documents real-world automation architectures, case studies, and technical tutorials for agencies and SaaS companies.

- [About Alfaz Mahmud Rizve](https://whoisalfaz.me/about/alfaz-mahmud-rizve/): RevOps automation architect and full-stack engineer. Credentials, client outcomes, and engineering philosophy.
- [Portfolio](https://whoisalfaz.me/portfolio/): Business growth strategies and the automated infrastructure designed to execute them.
- [Contact](https://whoisalfaz.me/contact/): Book a strategy call or request a technical SEO audit.

## Core Expertise

- Revenue Operations (RevOps) Architecture
- n8n Workflow Automation & Self-Hosting
- Full Stack Web Development (Next.js, React, Supabase)
- CRM Pipeline Engineering (HubSpot, Brevo, Apollo)
- AI Agent Integration & LLM Orchestration
- Technical SEO & Programmatic Indexing

## Cluster #2 — Vector DB & Self-Hosted AI Stack

- [Self-Hosted Qdrant Vultr Cluster: Docker SOP](https://whoisalfaz.me/blog/self-hosted-qdrant-cluster-vultr-docker-sop/): Production SOP for self-hosting Qdrant vector database on Vultr Cloud GPU with Docker Compose, mmap memory tuning, quantization, and n8n integration.
- [Vultr Cloud GPU vs AWS EC2: AI Cost Teardown](https://whoisalfaz.me/blog/vultr-cloud-gpu-vs-aws-ec2-ai-inference-cost-guide/): Comprehensive cost teardown comparing Vultr Cloud GPU and AWS EC2 for self-hosted AI inference, vector databases, and vLLM workloads.
- [Securing Self-Hosted Vector DBs: Vultr SOP](https://whoisalfaz.me/blog/securing-self-hosted-vector-databases-ssl-vultr-firewall/): Production security SOP for self-hosted vector databases on Vultr with Caddy TLS, Let's Encrypt SSL, UFW firewall rules, and API key authentication.
- [Self-Hosted AI Stack 2026: Vultr & n8n Guide](https://whoisalfaz.me/blog/the-ultimate-2026-self-hosted-ai-stack-vultr-qdrant-dify-n8n/): Complete architecture guide for deploying the ultimate 2026 self-hosted AI stack with Vultr GPU, Qdrant, Dify.ai, and n8n workflow automation.
- [Pinecone vs Qdrant Vultr: RAG Latency Benchmark](https://whoisalfaz.me/blog/pinecone-serverless-vs-qdrant-vultr-latency-benchmark/): Empirical p95/p99 latency, RAM throughput, and cost benchmark comparing Pinecone Serverless with self-hosted Qdrant on Vultr VPS for n8n RAG workflows.
- [Pinecone Namespaces vs Qdrant Payload Filters](https://whoisalfaz.me/blog/pinecone-namespaces-vs-qdrant-payload-filters-comparison/): Architectural breakdown comparing Pinecone Namespaces with Qdrant JSON Payload Filters for multi-tenant vector search in n8n RAG pipelines.
- [Hybrid Vector & Keyword Search: Qdrant n8n SOP](https://whoisalfaz.me/blog/hybrid-vector-keyword-search-qdrant-n8n-pipeline/): Step-by-step SOP for building hybrid dense vector and sparse keyword (BM25) search pipelines using self-hosted Qdrant and n8n workflow automation.
- [Scaling Qdrant to 10M Embeddings on Vultr VPS](https://whoisalfaz.me/blog/scaling-qdrant-vector-database-to-10-million-embeddings/): Production infrastructure guide for scaling self-hosted Qdrant vector database to 10 million vector embeddings on Vultr VPS with memory quantization and NVMe storage.
- [Corrective RAG CRAG Blueprint: n8n & Tavily](https://whoisalfaz.me/blog/corrective-rag-crag-blueprint-n8n-tavily-fallback/): Step-by-step Corrective RAG (CRAG) blueprint in n8n featuring Qdrant vector retrieval, automated evaluator grading logic, Tavily web search fallback, and context synthesis.
- [Automated PDF Document Chunking in n8n Guide](https://whoisalfaz.me/blog/automated-pdf-document-chunking-vectorization-n8n/): Master automated PDF document chunking and vectorization in n8n with semantic splitting algorithms, layout parsing, Qdrant vector database ingestion, and Pinecone serverless indexing.
- [Enterprise Knowledge Graph RAG in n8n Blueprint](https://whoisalfaz.me/blog/building-an-enterprise-knowledge-graph-rag-n8n/): Construct an enterprise Knowledge Graph RAG pipeline in n8n leveraging GraphRAG entity extraction, Neo4j graph databases, Qdrant vector stores, and automated relationship mapping.
- [Open-Source LLM Embeddings: BGE vs Voyage RAG](https://whoisalfaz.me/blog/open-source-llm-embeddings-voyage-bge-mxbai-n8n-benchmark/): Production benchmark and setup guide evaluating open-source LLM embeddings (BAAI BGE-M3, mixedbread mxbai-embed-large) versus Voyage AI (Voyage-large-2) and OpenAI text-embedding-3 inside n8n RAG pipelines.
- [Dify.ai Vultr GPU Docker Deployment Blueprint](https://whoisalfaz.me/blog/dify-ai-vultr-gpu-docker-deployment-guide/): Production SOP for deploying Dify.ai open-source LLM platform on Vultr Cloud GPU using Docker Compose, Redis, PostgreSQL, and Qdrant.
- [Dify.ai vs n8n AI Agents: Architecture Guide](https://whoisalfaz.me/blog/dify-ai-workflow-orchestration-vs-n8n-ai-agent-nodes/): In-depth architectural comparison between Dify.ai visual LLM orchestration and n8n AI agent workflows for enterprise automation.
- [Semantic Search API: n8n Qdrant FastAPI Guide](https://whoisalfaz.me/blog/semantic-search-api-n8n-qdrant-fastapi-bridge/): Build a production semantic search API bridging n8n, Qdrant vector database, and FastAPI with hybrid search and cross-encoder reranking.
- [Zero-Data-Retention Enterprise RAG: Vultr SOP](https://whoisalfaz.me/blog/zero-data-retention-enterprise-rag-vultr-vps/): Standard Operating Procedure for implementing Zero-Data-Retention Enterprise RAG on Vultr VPS using ephemeral vector memory and PII scrubbing.
- [Multi-Tenant Vector Search: n8n Qdrant Blueprint](https://whoisalfaz.me/blog/building-multi-tenant-vector-search-n8n-qdrant/): Blueprint for architecting isolated multi-tenant vector search pipelines using n8n workflows, Qdrant payload filters, security key scoping, and Vultr infrastructure.
- [n8n AI Agent Memory Persistence: Qdrant Guide](https://whoisalfaz.me/blog/n8n-vector-store-memory-management-production-guide/): Complete production guide for implementing hybrid n8n AI agent memory persistence using Qdrant vector storage, PostgreSQL chat history, and auto-archiving.
- [High-Throughput Batch Vector Ingestion: n8n SOP](https://whoisalfaz.me/blog/high-throughput-batch-vector-ingestion-n8n-qdrant/): Step-by-step SOP for architecting high-throughput batch vector ingestion pipelines in n8n with Qdrant, concurrency limits, and retry queues on Vultr.
- [n8n Context Compression: Qdrant Memory Guide](https://whoisalfaz.me/blog/n8n-ai-agent-memory-persistence-qdrant-vector-store/): In-depth guide on implementing n8n context compression with Qdrant vector memory to eliminate token window bloat and reduce LLM inference costs.
